scope: All 193 indexed Temporal source article identities, reconciled non-destructively against existing 39 major Calendar source candidates.
policy: A label-based priority is a triage suggestion, not proof a canonical ID, text, feast or user-facing explanation is missing.
Avoid copying article full text, modern French translations or images.
Edition/version flags are heuristic except the documented internal Holy Saturday contradiction; independent 1962 witness needed.
Preserve all source URLs and original titles; page HTML hashes are research fingerprints, not attribution or rights evidence.
The 164 Temporal and non-Temporal sources outside the 39 celebration sample require actual registry matching; never publish by label similarity.
